description: What InternetData knows about one domain, from its latest snapshots rather than a live DNS query: whether it is registered, which DNS record types it has, the records themselves, its organization's IP ranges, and whether it is a disposable email domain. Always read `coverage.note` before concluding anything from a field that is not in the result.

domain.description: The domain to look up, such as `example.com`.

name: lookup_domain

coverage.description: Which datasets this result covered. Read `note` before interpreting any absent field.

result.description: What every database says about one domain.

cap_reached.description: On every answer to a key on a paid plan, and on no other: `false` while the answer has every field, `true` once its organization's overage cap is reached and the answer has Unlimited's. Lookups answered past the cap are not billed; raising or removing the cap in Billing turns it `false` again.

disposable.description: `{}` when `is_disposable` is false. Paid plans and the trial.

first_seen.description: The first day seen in use.

dns.description: Its records in Domain DNS, up to 100 a type. Paid plans and the trial.

last_seen.description: The last day the snapshot saw it.
The last day the snapshot saw it.

domain.description: The domain, lowercase and in punycode.

ip_ranges.description: The organization's IP ranges, from Domain IP Ranges. Paid plans and the trial.

ranges.description: The first 1000, IPv4 before IPv6, the largest first.

redirects_to.description: Where its home page redirects, when that is how it was reached.

is_disposable.description: In Disposable Domain. Paid plans and the trial.

is_registered.description: In Domain List: a registered domain.

trial_expired.description: On every answer to a key on the free plan, and on no other: `false` while its organization's trial of every field lasts, `true` once the answer has Unlimited's fields.

title: Look up a domain
